semantic_mapping.semantic_assessment: Closed catalog/case/task/oracle fields, finite counts and byte bounds, known setup/kind/tag values, safe path and collision checks, exact UTF-8 content hashes and canonical fixture/oracle digests are checked before returning the description. JSON loading rejects duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers and invalid UTF-8. Unknown case is refused by materialize.

semantic_mapping.semantic_assessment: Materialize revalidates supplied catalog/content hashes before effects; requires exactly one selected case and a new destination under an existing caller-trusted parent; checks destination/ancestors for links/reparse points. Fixed bounded Git commands construct committed/unborn/detached/linked/sparse arrangements, then declared staged/working edits; evaluator is sibling to solver. Existing/linked paths and failed setup stop; partial owned placement can remain. No second concurrent-source CAS is claimed.

semantic_mapping.semantic_assessment: Every fixed Git call uses check=True and 20-second timeout; failed commands cannot reach the return. Successful path records identities/oracle outside solver, obtains no-follow regular-file snapshot and returns solver/evaluator/task/setup/files. Snapshot refuses links/reparse/nonregular files; failure can leave owned partial output and caller must use a fresh destination. This is returned fixture-placement evidence, not independent verification of solver confinement.
